style: Chanson-cabaret and acoustic avant-folk ensemble staging. [HARMONY SYSTEM] 11-Limit just intonation with pure ratio intervals and modal drone fields. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Angular cabaret patter opening into front-rounded French melismas and microtonal vocal runs. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Polymetric 7/8 against 4/4 with additive Balkan pulses and steady mbira anchor. [TIMBRE SYSTEM] Bright metallic mbira tines, upright bass slap, accordion bellows, and chest-percussion thuds. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Theatrical motivational seminar overstatement played with deadpan urgency. [PRODUCTION] Pristine vintage room capture with concentric spatial ring separation and abrupt tape stops. Hold mbira anchor fixed while metric layers migrate; compress vowel duration while stretching interval ratios; make speech act like percussion without losing syllable clarity; return to the anchor in a more mutated form under critical physical stress.

caption: An avant-folk cabaret motivational seminar governed by 11-limit just intonation, hocketed vocal ensembles, and a central mbira pulse. Structured through recursive fractal decomposition and interrupted by live audience heckling, the piece applies molecular scale rules to corporate breakthrough mechanics.
